card.name: Open parenthesis before abbreviations; digits before mL
card.fires_on: The open parenthesis right after a spelled-out term, where an abbreviation is about to be given, such as toxic epidermal necrolysis or Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy. Also digits like 5 or 0 inside volume amounts just before mL.

modes.label: Parenthesis before acronym
modes.description: An open parenthesis after a full medical term, just before its capital-letter abbreviation.
modes.example: IOUS AND SOMETIMES FATAL DERMATOLOGIC REACTIONS, INCLUDING TOXIC EPIDERMAL NECROLYSIS<< (>>TEN) AND STEVENS-J

modes.label: Digit before mL
modes.description: A digit in a volume amount, directly before mL.
modes.example: 75 mL 66 mL 125 mL 110 mL 200 mL 176 mL Each <<5>> mL will contain 600 mg

card.writes: It promotes short capital-letter abbreviations, so it prepares the model to write an acronym.
card.plain: It fires where a full term is followed by a bracket that will hold its abbreviation, and on digits in mL amounts.
